title: A backup takes half the LAN traffic
scenario: R1 should use 10.0.12.2 for branch 192.168.20.0/24 and reserve 10.0.13.2 as standby. Both transit links work. Traffic to .50 uses standby while .150 uses primary. Excerpts are representative.
question: Which error explains this?
options: The higher backup AD makes it preferred for every destination.
The backup is a separate /25 prefix and wins for .0 through .127.
The two overlapping prefixes form equal-cost paths for all hosts.
The primary must be removed for the backup to float.
explanation: The /25 covers .50 and wins longest match. .150 does not match it. AD is not compared between different installed prefix lengths; overlapping prefixes are not equal-cost paths, and removing the primary defeats standby operation.
fix:
```ios R1
R1# configure terminal
R1(config)# no ip route 192.168.20.0 255.255.255.128 10.0.13.2 5
R1(config)# ip route 192.168.20.0 255.255.255.0 10.0.13.2 5
R1(config)# end
R1# show ip route static
```
Only the distance-1 /24 should remain selected while the primary works. Verify both destination decisions, then test primary-link failure and recovery in the isolated lab before saving.

title: Router ping works; PC ping fails
scenario: PC-A is 192.168.10.11/24, gateway 192.168.10.1 on R1. PC-B is 192.168.20.12/24, gateway 192.168.20.1 on R2. Local/transit pings work, with no filtering. R1's ping uses source 10.0.12.1 and succeeds; PC-A's fails.

exhibits.title: Complete relevant R2 routes; no default

question: Which repair addresses the evidence?
options: Add another outbound route to PC-B on R1.
Use R2's own 10.0.12.2 as the return next hop.
explanation: R2's connected /30 covers the router's ping source, but no route covers PC-A. The outbound route exists, /16 violates the plan, and R2's own address is not its next router.
fix:
```ios R2
R2# configure terminal
R2(config)# ip route 192.168.10.0 255.255.255.0 gigabitethernet0/0 10.0.12.1
R2(config)# end
R2# show ip route static
```
Repeat PC-A-to-PC-B and reverse pings. Both should succeed under the stated conditions. Verify before saving.
